g.text: OpenMeet Room: interview in the browser, interviewer computer and candidate device
checks.py: fusion of the four signals
The candidate's join page states what
happens; flags, scores and the interviewer's
notes are never sent to the candidate.
(gaze frame ~10 per s, status 1 per s)
video and audio never reach the server
questions and answers text, names removed
